correctness.rationale: The line-graph interaction sum is exactly J/2 sum q_i² −Jn(n−1)/2 and magnetization is (1/2)sum q_i. Strict convexity of the discrete local charge energy leaves one or two adjacent optimal charges. The parity of total positive-edge degrees and an edge-switch minimization establish graphical realizability for all almost-regular prescribed degree vectors; when an all-equal optimum is non-graphical, a single nearest-charge defect is minimal. At h near saturation, these degree patterns produce the stated matchings, P3-plus-matching, isolated-vertex-plus-matching, and telephone-number saturation count. Independently enumerated all labelled spin states for n=4,5,6 (64,1024,32768 states), checking every half-integer field through and beyond saturation, with exact agreement in ground profiles. Finite checks only corroborate the all-n graph-theoretic proof.
